title: Manzwiro Acho Anopfuura Nepamawere
intro: Fungidzira mupata une dzimba dzakacherwa kubva pamawere, uye mhepo ine ndangariro yeyambiro isina kuteererwa. Vanhu vakambobudirira pano, vakaropafadzwa asi vasingateereri, kusvikira chiratidzo chabuda padombo ravaivimba naro.
clues: Taiva vanhu vaigadzira dzimba dzakachengeteka kubva kumakomo, vachinzwa vakachengeteka mudzimba dzedu dzine matombo.
Taigara munyika ine mapani nematombo, yakakomborerwa neminda nezvitubu.
Mutumwa aibva pakati pedu akauya, achitidana kuti tisiye vamwari vedu venhema tonamata Musiki mumwe chete wechokwadi.
Takazvikudza tichiisa murairo wekutenda: chiratidzo chakasiyana chaizobuda mumatombo atakaveza.
Ngamera diki yakavimbiswa payakabuda mudombo, chiratidzo chakajeka, vakuru vedu vakaramba vachiri kuicheka makumbo pasinei nenyevero yekuparadzwa kwaizouya.
Mazuva matatu mushure mechiito chedu, kurira kukuru kwakanzwika mumupata, uye takaparadzwa kuita matongo, dzimba dzedu dzakava makuva edu.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
